head: nok-2
rule: นอก is the outside, and the split is spatial against relational. Sense 1 is physically outside something — ภายนอก, นอกชาน (the terrace past the eaves), คนไข้นอก. Sense 2 is being outside a GROUP or a bound rather than a wall: คนนอก an outsider, นอกเรื่อง off the subject, นอกจาก excepted from, and นอกใจ, going outside a marriage. Sense 3 is abroad and takes นักเรียนนอก, one who studied overseas, beside ของนอก already there — note the head has three separate senses (3, 4, 5) for degrees of foreignness, and only the plainest of them is used here.

3: นักเรียนนอก
